verdict.rationale: Docs describe a concrete documented skill format (SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter + markdown instructions), a CLI (`openclaw skills`) to build/test/install/verify skills from local directories or Git, plus MCP tool integration and plugin install without restart, giving developers a documented path to author and load local skills/tools/plugins into their instance. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer report confirming a self-authored skill actually loads and runs as documented, and deeper documentation of the plugin (non-skill) API surface.
